subject: Re: Nimbus status - memo landing Friday, one scope cut
body:
Wrapping up. The Project Nimbus recommendation memo goes out Friday and says: adopt for offline evaluation and candidate ranking, do not put it on a robot yet.

Rationale is Rafael's coverage finding. Reward-free training on 1.9TB of unlabeled logs is genuinely valuable to us and the benchmark reproduction is solid. But 12% of proposed steps landing outside the data's support is a safety conversation, not a metrics conversation, and the uncertainty gate is a Q3 item with its own owner.

Scope cut: the Jul 3 "run on our own logs" milestone shipped as a measurement study, not a deployed policy. I've already told the robotics folks, so nobody is expecting a demo.

Eleni - the reward-free stability result is the part I think is worth a broader read.

Thanks all, this was a well-run one.

Ulla
